Sam (AE): Quick sync: Elena wants a short POC to validate integration with our SDKs, streaming chat UX, auth rotation, and quota behavior. 3-week target. Any blockers?
Rae (SE): Proposed minimum scope: 1) JS + Python SDK quickstarts + example repo, 2) SSE-based streaming demo, 3) eval set (10 prompts + pass/fail rubric), 4) telemetry hooks (X-Request-ID) and sample traces.
Elena (Customer): We need server API keys that can be rotated via API, browser short-lived tokens, and per-request audit logs. Also curious about default rate limits.
Yara (Security): For browser tokens use STS pattern, short TTL (1h). We'll provide SOC2 summary and an answers doc for their security questionnaire. Need confirmation on log retention and KMS options.
Tom (SRE): Default test quotas we can allocate: 200 req/min baseline, burst to 500 for short windows. Concurrent streaming connections limited to 50 org-wide by default. For sustained >500/min we recommend a Dedicated eval.
Rae (SE): Integration notes: Authorization: Bearer <key>. For browser flows have backend exchange to create short-lived token. Streaming: SSE example is simplest for web demos; websockets available for bi-directional cases. Retry recommendations: exponential backoff starting 200ms, cap 5s, max 5 retries, use idempotency keys for request dedupe.
Elena (Customer): Success criteria they care about: p50 latency <300ms for short queries, streaming handshake <400ms, >=80% pass rate on eval rubric, and console access to logs + request IDs. Is that feasible?
Rae (SE): Feasible if we pick a low-latency quantized variant and keep interactive routes unbatched. We'll enable KV caching for repeated prefixes.
Yara (Security): For key rotation, hosted console supports rotation; we can provide an API flow demo. If they insist on customer-managed keys, we can discuss Private deployment options and KMS integration.
Sam (AE): Timeline suggestion: Week1: auth + SDK hookup; Week2: streaming demo + telemetry; Week3: load tests + evals + wrap.
Tom (SRE): Load plan: run synthetic traffic up to 600 req/min in 20m windows to validate behavior and fallbacks. We'll provision temporary quota bump.
Rae (SE): Action items: - Rae: prepare SDK quickstarts + sample SSE demo (48h) - Tom: provision test quota bump and schedule load window (48h) - Yara: send SOC2 excerpt + STS flow doc (24h) - Sam: provide pricing estimate to customer (EOD) - Elena: upload 10 eval prompts + rubric by Tue
ops-bot: reminder set for 2026-05-10 17:00 UTC 8 "POC kickoff: Elena 10am PT"
Elena (Customer): Thanks all, I'll upload prompts and invite Rae.
Sam (AE): Please flag any legal/compliance blockers here so we can escalate.
